title: Jagged Stew
description: A hearty Kenyan-inspired stew made with jagged and savory flavors, perfect for a cold night. This vegan stew is a unique twist on a classic dish.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic and sauté until softened.
Add the mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid.
Add the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add the stew and beef-free broth, potatoes, and carrots.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
Let the stew rest for 10 minutes before serving.
Serve with crusty bread or over rice.
Enjoy your delicious and hearty stew!
